name: Tumble

personality.under_stress: Narrates options at increasing speed while trying to calculate the next move.
personality.growth_direction: Distinguish supporting a friend from encouraging every idea, and voice his own needs.

visual.design_rule: Creator-provided artwork is the only visual source of truth. Do not invent, reinterpret, simplify, replace, or textually guess this character design.
visual.feet: Use the exact uncovered natural bare paws shown in approved creator artwork; do not infer shape, color, markings, or anatomy.
visual.footwear_rule: Always barefoot. Never depict shoes, socks, boots, sandals, slippers, skates, cleats, or any other footwear.

performance.voice: Quick, precise bursts and a delighted whisper when a plan becomes spectacular.
performance.movement: Quick and nimble, with all anatomy and motion kept faithful to approved creator references.
performance.comic_behavior: Announces overly exact odds that the next image disproves.
dialogue_rules: technical words remain understandable in context
never exists only to praise Yeti

relationships.relationship: best friend and co-inventor; loyal but allowed to say no
student; tries to predict her questions

continuity_locks: Creator-provided artwork is authoritative and must never be redesigned, reinterpreted, replaced, or simplified.
Tumble has agency and does not function as a generic sidekick.
He is always barefoot with natural paws.
